1649. Inheritance, Super, Constructors

70

Hard

Library Book Borrowing System
Problem Statement
Design a program for a Library Book Borrowing System using inheritance.

Description:
Design a program where LibraryItem is a base class. Book and Magazine inherit from it. Use method overriding to calculate the late fee depending on the type of item.
1. Books charge ₹5/day late
2. Magazines charge ₹2/day late
Use constructors and super keyword to initialize.

Input Format:
First line: type of item (book or magazine)
Second line: number of late days

Output Format:
Late fee in ₹
